text: The City Clerk's Office has received notice that Lori DeGraw, Chair of the Board of Directors of TO Live, has resigned effective November 28, 2025. We would like to thank Lori for their contributions to the board. Staff from the Public Appointments Secretariat in the City Clerk's Office are leading a process to recruit applicants and help bring a nominated candidate to City Council for consideration.
The Board of Directors of TO Live received the item for information.
